description: This file implements a React context and hook for managing toast notifications in a frontend application. It defines types for toasts and context API, provides a ToastProvider component to render and manage toast messages, and exposes a useToast hook for components to interact with the toast system.

methods.name: useToast
methods.description: Hook to access toast API in client components, providing methods to add, remove, and clear toasts.

methods.name: ToastProvider
methods.description: React component that provides toast management context and renders toast notifications UI.
